outcome: Maternal outcomes (death, length of hospital admission, complications)
cohort: Women who underwent EPH in public hospitals in Metro East, Cape Town, South Africa, from November 2014 to November 2015
finding: The study found a high incidence of EPH in the study population, with repeat cesarean delivery being strongly associated with EPH, and sepsis-related EPH being associated with worse clinical characteristics compared to hemorrhage-related EPH.
mod_finding: The study found that 86% of women who underwent EPH had delivered by cesarean section, and 45% of those were repeat cesarean deliveries.
